description: This Java source file defines an abstract class for a Vert.x-based CoAP protocol adapter within the Eclipse Hono project. It provides core functionalities such as server setup, resource management, secure and insecure endpoint binding, message forwarding, and device authentication. Designed to be extended for specific protocol implementations, it facilitates CoAP communication handling, metrics reporting, and integration with the Hono messaging infrastructure.

classes.name: AbstractVertxBasedCoapAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class providing core CoAP server setup, resource management, and message forwarding functionalities for a Vert.x-based Hono protocol adapter.

methods.name: setHonoDeviceResolver
methods.description: Sets the device resolver for authenticating CoAP clients.

methods.name: setPskStore
methods.description: Sets the PSK store used for DTLS pre-shared key authentication.

methods.name: setMetrics
methods.description: Injects the metrics reporting component.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves the current metrics component.

methods.name: setResources
methods.description: Adds CoAP resources to the server.

methods.name: getPortDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default secure CoAP port (coaps).

methods.name: getInsecurePortDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default insecure CoAP port (coap).

methods.name: getActualPort
methods.description: Returns the actual secure port the server is listening on.

methods.name: getActualInsecurePort
methods.description: Returns the actual insecure port the server is listening on.

methods.name: setCoapServer
methods.description: Sets a specific CoapServer instance to be used.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Starts the CoAP server with configured resources and endpoints.

methods.name: addResources
methods.description: Adds user-defined resources to the CoAP server.

methods.name: bindSecureEndpoint
methods.description: Configures and binds a secure DTLS endpoint.

methods.name: bindInsecureEndpoint
methods.description: Configures and binds an insecure endpoint based on configuration.

methods.name: preStartup
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to execute logic before server startup.

methods.name: onStartupSuccess
methods.description: Hook for subclasses after successful startup.

methods.name: getSecureNetworkConfig
methods.description: Creates and loads network configuration for the secure endpoint.

methods.name: getInsecureNetworkConfig
methods.description: Creates and loads network configuration for the insecure endpoint.

methods.name: loadNetworkConfig
methods.description: Loads network configuration parameters from a properties file.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamMessage
methods.description: Allows subclasses to customize downstream messages before sending.

methods.name: doStop
methods.description: Stops the CoAP server and performs cleanup.

methods.name: preShutdown
methods.description: Hook for subclasses before shutdown.

methods.name: postShutdown
methods.description: Hook for subclasses after shutdown.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedExtendedDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the authenticated device identity for a request.

methods.name: uploadTelemetryMessage
methods.description: Forwards telemetry payload to the downstream Telemetry API.

methods.name: uploadEventMessage
methods.description: Forwards event payload to the downstream Event API.

methods.name: doUploadMessage
methods.description: Core logic for forwarding messages to downstream APIs, with metrics and error handling.

methods.name: isGatewayMappingEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if device gateway mapping is enabled; returns always true.
